resources.string: Hi, thank you for calling [enter business name]. We’re currently assisting a client and unable to answer. Book online: [enter website URL]. You can also reply to this SMS and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. How can we help you? Reply: 1 — Prices and services; 2 — Today’s availability or cancellations; 3 — Book an appointment; 4 — Human assistance. View online bookings, current availability and prices, or join our waiting list here: [enter website URL]

1,price,cost,how much,one hour,60 minute,60 minutes,60 mins,massage price=>Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. A 60-minute appointment starts from $[enter price]. Specialised equipment, treatment tools and add-on services may have separate charges. View full prices here: [enter website URL]. Reply HUMAN if you would like personal assistance.
3,book,booking,book online,make an appointment=>Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. You can view available appointments and book online here: [enter website URL]. Reply HUMAN if you need personal assistance.
2,availability,available,slot,appointment,cancellation,cancelled,cancellation today,any cancellation today,availability today,available today,same day,last minute,afternoon,this afternoon,today,tomorrow,tonight=>Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. You can check our current availability and cancellations here: [enter website URL]. If you cannot find a suitable time, reply HUMAN with your preferred day and time. A team member will respond as soon as possible.
address,location,where,clinic address,directions=>Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. Our address is: [enter clinic address]. Reply HUMAN if you need directions or personal assistance.
happy ending,happy endings,extra service,extra services,special service,sexual service=>Hi, this is the automated SMS assistant for [enter business name]. We do offer a happy ending: hopefully, you leave with less pain and better movement! We provide professional therapeutic services only—no sexual services. If you mean treatment add-ons, specialised tools or equipment, reply HUMAN and we’ll explain the available options and prices.
4,human,human assistance,speak to someone,real person,call me=>Your request for human assistance has been received. Our team may be assisting another client. Please leave your name and enquiry, and a team member will reply as soon as possible.
